recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work on Identifier URI systems should build on the current FHIR-19602/FHIR-45479 wording rather than restoring the older combined example.
issue_request: FHIR-8597 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I DSTU1 change request asking to clarify Identifier.system text so that "if the id itself is a full uri" explicitly meant the identifier value, i.e. Identifier.value.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 6603, represented in git as 7206db80270f5d9338418df08e19242213643295, by changing the Identifier.system spreadsheet example from "if the id itself is a full uri" to "if the Identifier.value itself is a full uri". Later commit 2f577a81d2c0833f5bbe23b020262257b89339cc removed that combined acme/RFC3986 example during broader Identifier example cleanup.
additional_context: Identifier is active in source/fhir.ini and source/datatypes/identifier.xml remains build-scope source. The current Identifier.system row no longer contains the ambiguous old phrase, while the Identifier.value detailed comment and datatypes narrative now describe globally unique URI values and the urn:ietf:rfc:3986 fallback. The already published FHIR-19602 reconciliation commit aligned that active wording with later Identifier URI-system decisions, including FHIR-45479.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Restoring the old Identifier.system example or duplicating the Identifier.value rule would be redundant and could conflict with the later, more precise RFC3986 fallback wording.

related_jiras.note: A later Published Identifier URI-system clarification already fixed the active Identifier.value detailed comment on the combined branch.
A later Applied clarification supports the current model that specific assigned systems may exist and urn:ietf:rfc:3986 is the no-assigned-system fallback.
